assertionAdaptation: Only expected entry pathname gains the actual Pages prefix. Predicate, polling(default rAF), deep equality and 15000ms timeout remain exact.
method: Fresh Chromium process and viewport-only desktop context per trial; active real service worker. Shared HTTPS/H2/gzip6 origin + single aggregate CONNECT link cap includes SW traffic. Original QA browser launch flags. No trace/screencast, no warmup navigation, no offline-ready wait, no forced focus, no artificial delay/hold, no app/test edits. Base cannot show Home until full offline preparation; its natural completed status is the architectural control. Core Home click immediately at first actionable Home, then accepted deep fight-phase route and exact first on-page Ctrl-click target. Unrelated all-chapter/reload warmup is omitted deliberately.
